PM Modi and US VP Vance Discuss Strategic Partnership Over Phone

Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with US Vice President JD Vance over the phone. The discussion focused on strengthening the India-US strategic partnership. Both leaders explored ways to deepen bilateral cooperation between the two nations. The call underscored the ongoing commitment to enhancing the relationship.
